name: jev.nonstream.minimal-schema-request-from-ir
description: An IR request produced by Jev decode reconstructs the original Jev request: template-stripped state string and schema-derived questions; choice criteria degrade to option-name descriptions with one loss.

system.text:
The customer said the delivery was late but the product quality was excellent.

Answer the structured questions that follow as a single JSON object. Keys MUST be exactly the question IDs given in the user message; values MUST match each question's type: noul answers are numbers in [0,1], choice answers are one of the listed option names, score answers are one of the listed level numbers. Output raw JSON only: no prose, no markdown fences.

content.text:
question sentiment (choice): What is the overall sentiment of this feedback?
criteria:
- mixed: Customer has both good and bad things to say
- negative: Customer is unhappy overall
- positive: Customer is happy overall

sentiment.description: What is the overall sentiment of this feedback?

expected_output.state: The customer said the delivery was late but the product quality was excellent.

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of this feedback?

expected_losses.detail: N-JEV-9: criteria descriptions live in the prompt text
